# Draft:Iván Cepeda 2026 presidential campaign

----
On August 22, 2025, Senator Iván Cepeda announced his candidacy for the 2026 Historic Pact presidential primaries during a political event. Cepeda became the official candidate of the Historic Pact on October 26, 2026, after obtaining 1,522,347 votes, which represented a margin of 37.01% against Minister Carolina Corcho.
Cepeda, a senator for Bogotá, D.C. from 2014 to 2025 and a representative from 2010 to 2014, had been the subject of widespread speculation as a possible candidate for 2026.
